updateCadence: Roughly every few weeks tracking Fenix (2.51.0 on Oct 20, 2.51.1 on Oct 26)
summary: Fenix-based fork whose main point is add-on freedom: install almost any Firefox add-on instead of Mozilla's curated mobile list. Updated from GitHub (2.51.1, Oct 26, 2026) and not on Google Play or official F-Droid.
bestFor: Firefox Android users wanting full add-on access
notFor: People who want signed store-distributed builds

pros.title: Broad add-on access
pros.detail: Try nearly any Firefox add-on, not only Mozilla's recommended few.

pros.title: Tracks Firefox closely
pros.detail: 2.51.1 is based on Fenix 158.0.2, days after upstream.

pros.title: Fission option
pros.detail: 2.49.0 added a setting to enable site isolation.

pros.title: Firefox Sync available
pros.detail: Close fork of Firefox for Android, so Sync works (unverified).

cons.title: Alpha-quality builds
cons.detail: Maintainers say the signing method means you may not want to rely on it.

cons.title: GitHub only
cons.detail: Not on Google Play or official F-Droid; APKMirror lags GitHub.

cons.title: Telemetry unclear
cons.detail: Not a de-Googled/de-Mozilla fork; telemetry removal undocumented.

cons.title: Fission off by default
cons.detail: Site isolation must be switched on manually.

faq.a: No; releases are APKs on GitHub (APKMirror mirrors with a lag).
Mainly add-on availability beyond Mozilla's recommended list.

faq.q: Is it safe to rely on?
faq.a: Maintainers call it alpha-quality because of how releases are signed.

switching.note: Firefox Sync account works (unverified); no import wizard documented.

jsSpeed: SpiderMonkey, slower than V8 on Android
privacyDefaults: Firefox ETP standard; telemetry not removed
securityHardening: Fission off by default; unofficial signing
advancedSettings: Extra Fenix options plus add-on collection
extensions: Almost any Firefox add-on on Android

featureNotes.fingerprintProtection: ETP fingerprinter blocking; no RFP on Android
featureNotes.queryStripping: Firefox URL parameter stripping in strict/private
featureNotes.cookieBanners: Firefox cookie banner reduction (unverified on Android)
featureNotes.passwordManager: Firefox login manager; can use other autofill
